TemplateBody:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Screen Art IAM foundation UPDATE review: existing roles preserved; independent runtime roles; no messaging
  or consumers'
Rules:
  ScreenArtOnly:
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: AWS::AccountId
        - '365470560685'
      AssertDescription: Screen Art only
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: AWS::Region
        - eu-west-1
      AssertDescription: Ireland only
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: AWS::StackName
        - muserelay-aws-bridge-iam-foundation
      AssertDescription: Reviewed foundation name only
Resources:
  StageCloudFormationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-cfn-execution
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
          Action: sts:AssumeRole
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      Policies:
      - PolicyName: bridge-stage-scoped
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
          - Sid: CreateOnlySymmetricDemoKey
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - kms:CreateKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
                kms:KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
                kms:KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
                aws:RequestTag/Company: ScreenArt
                aws:RequestTag/Component: aws-engagement-bridge
                aws:RequestTag/Environment: staging
              Bool:
                kms:BypassPolicyLockoutSafetyCheck: 'false'
          - Sid: TagKeyAtCreation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - kms:TagResource
            Resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:365470560685:key/*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
                aws:RequestTag/Company: ScreenArt
                aws:RequestTag/Component: aws-engagement-bridge
                aws:RequestTag/Environment: staging
          - Sid: ReadRegionalKeyMetadata
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - kms:DescribeKey
            - kms:GetKeyPolicy
            - kms:GetKeyRotationStatus
            - kms:ListResourceTags
            Resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:365470560685:key/*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
          - Sid: NamedAliasOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - kms:CreateAlias
            - kms:UpdateAlias
            - kms:DeleteAlias
            Resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:365470560685:alias/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-sns
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
          - Sid: ReadAliasRegistry
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - kms:ListAliases
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
          - Sid: StageTopicAndSubscriptionOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - sns:CreateTopic
            - sns:DeleteTopic
            - sns:GetTopicAttributes
            - sns:SetTopicAttributes
            - sns:TagResource
            - sns:UntagResource
            - sns:ListTagsForResource
            - sns:Subscribe
            - sns:Unsubscribe
            - sns:GetSubscriptionAttributes
            - sns:SetSubscriptionAttributes
            - sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic
            - sns:GetDataProtectionPolicy
            Resource: arn:aws:sns:eu-west-1:365470560685:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
          - Sid: StageQueuesOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - sqs:CreateQueue
            - sqs:DeleteQueue
            - sqs:GetQueueUrl
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            - sqs:SetQueueAttributes
            - sqs:TagQueue
            - sqs:UntagQueue
            - sqs:ListQueueTags
            Resource:
            - arn:aws:sqs:eu-west-1:365470560685:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound-queue
            - arn:aws:sqs:eu-west-1:365470560685:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound-dlq
            - arn:aws:sqs:eu-west-1:365470560685:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-sns-delivery-dlq
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
          - Sid: PrivateArtifactBucketOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - s3:CreateBucket
            - s3:DeleteBucket
            - s3:GetBucketLocation
            - s3:ListBucket
            - s3:GetBucketAcl
            - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
            - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
            - s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock
            - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
            - s3:GetBucketOwnershipControls
            - s3:PutBucketOwnershipControls
            - s3:GetBucketTagging
            - s3:PutBucketTagging
            - s3:GetBucketPolicy
            - s3:PutBucketPolicy
            - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
            - s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration
            - s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration
            - s3:GetAccelerateConfiguration
            - s3:GetAnalyticsConfiguration
            - s3:GetBucketAbac
            - s3:GetBucketCORS
            - s3:GetBucketLogging
            - s3:GetBucketMetadataTableConfiguration
            - s3:GetBucketNotification
            - s3:GetBucketObjectLockConfiguration
            - s3:GetBucketVersioning
            - s3:GetBucketWebsite
            - s3:GetIntelligentTieringConfiguration
            - s3:GetInventoryConfiguration
            - s3:GetMetricsConfiguration
            - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
            - s3:ListTagsForResource
            - s3:TagResource
            - s3:UntagResource
            Resource: arn:aws:s3:::muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-artifacts-365470560685-eu-west-1
          - Sid: PreventKeyDestructionFromDeployment
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
            - kms:DisableKey
            - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
            Resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:365470560685:key/*
      - PolicyName: bridge-runtime-receive-provisioning
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
          - Sid: PassOnlyInboundRuntime
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - iam:PassRole
            Resource: arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound-runtime
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: lambda.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: InboundFunctionProvisioning
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - lambda:CreateFunction
            - lambda:GetFunction
            - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
            - lambda:GetFunctionCodeSigningConfig
            - lambda:GetFunctionConcurrency
            - lambda:UpdateFunctionCode
            - lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration
            - lambda:DeleteFunction
            - lambda:PutFunctionConcurrency
            - lambda:DeleteFunctionConcurrency
            - lambda:TagResource
            - lambda:UntagResource
            - lambda:ListTags
            Resource: arn:aws:lambda:eu-west-1:365470560685:function:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
          - Sid: CreateOnlyInboundMapping
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - lambda:CreateEventSourceMapping
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
              ArnEquals:
                lambda:FunctionArn: arn:aws:lambda:eu-west-1:365470560685:function:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound
          - Sid: ManageOnlyInboundMapping
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - lambda:GetEventSourceMapping
            - lambda:UpdateEventSourceMapping
            - lambda:DeleteEventSourceMapping
            Resource: arn:aws:lambda:eu-west-1:365470560685:event-source-mapping:*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
              ArnEquals:
                lambda:FunctionArn: arn:aws:lambda:eu-west-1:365470560685:function:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound
          - Sid: OwnStateTableProvisioning
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - dynamodb:CreateTable
            - dynamodb:DeleteTable
            - dynamodb:DescribeTable
            - dynamodb:UpdateTable
            - dynamodb:UpdateTimeToLive
            - dynamodb:DescribeTimeToLive
            - dynamodb:TagResource
            - dynamodb:UntagResource
            - dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource
            Resource: arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-west-1:365470560685:table/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-state
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
          - Sid: EmptySigningSecretMetadata
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
            - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
            - secretsmanager:TagResource
            - secretsmanager:UntagResource
            - secretsmanager:ListSecretVersionIds
            - secretsmanager:GetResourcePolicy
            Resource: arn:aws:secretsmanager:eu-west-1:365470560685:secret:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage/signing-??????
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
          - Sid: OwnLogGroupProvisioning
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - logs:CreateLogGroup
            - logs:DeleteLogGroup
            - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
            - logs:DeleteRetentionPolicy
            - logs:TagResource
            - logs:UntagResource
            - logs:ListTagsForResource
            Resource:
            - arn:aws:logs:eu-west-1:365470560685:log-group:/aws/lambda/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound
            - arn:aws:logs:eu-west-1:365470560685:log-group:/aws/lambda/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound:*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
          - Sid: RegionalLogGroupMetadata
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - logs:DescribeLogGroups
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
          - Sid: ReadReviewedArtifact
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - s3:GetObject
            Resource: arn:aws:s3:::muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-artifacts-365470560685-eu-west-1/releases/*/bridge.zip
          - Sid: AllowAwsSamTransformInIreland
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
            Resource: arn:aws:cloudformation:eu-west-1:aws:transform/Serverless-2016-10-31
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  KmsRecoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: muserelay-aws-bridge-kms-recovery
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            AWS: arn:aws:iam::365470560685:root
          Action: sts:AssumeRole
          Condition:
            ArnLike:
              aws:PrincipalArn: arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/aws-reserved/sso.amazonaws.com/eu-west-1/AWSReservedSSO_AdministratorAccess_*
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      Policies:
      - PolicyName: bridge-stage-scoped
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
          - Sid: RecoverTaggedStageKeyPolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - kms:DescribeKey
            - kms:GetKeyPolicy
            - kms:PutKeyPolicy
            Resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:365470560685:key/*
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1
                aws:ResourceTag/Company: ScreenArt
                aws:ResourceTag/Component: aws-engagement-bridge
                aws:ResourceTag/Environment: staging
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  InboundExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound-runtime
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
          Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
      - PolicyName: bridge-runtime
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
          - Sid: OwnState
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            Resource: arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-west-1:365470560685:table/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-state
          - Sid: OwnSigningSecret
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: arn:aws:secretsmanager:eu-west-1:365470560685:secret:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage/signing-??????
          - Sid: OwnLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - logs:CreateLogStream
            - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: arn:aws:logs:eu-west-1:365470560685:log-group:/aws/lambda/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound:*
          - Sid: OwnQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            - sqs:DeleteMessage
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: arn:aws:sqs:eu-west-1:365470560685:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound-queue
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  EnqueueExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-enqueue-runtime
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
          Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
      - PolicyName: bridge-runtime
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
          - Sid: OwnState
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            Resource: arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-west-1:365470560685:table/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-state
          - Sid: OwnSigningSecret
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: arn:aws:secretsmanager:eu-west-1:365470560685:secret:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage/signing-outbound-??????
          - Sid: OwnLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - logs:CreateLogStream
            - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: arn:aws:logs:eu-west-1:365470560685:log-group:/aws/lambda/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-enqueue:*
          - Sid: OwnOutboundQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: arn:aws:sqs:eu-west-1:365470560685:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-outbound-queue
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  SenderExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-sender-runtime
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
          Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
      - PolicyName: bridge-runtime
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
          - Sid: OwnState
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            Resource: arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-west-1:365470560685:table/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-state
          - Sid: OwnSigningSecret
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: arn:aws:secretsmanager:eu-west-1:365470560685:secret:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage/signing-??????
          - Sid: OwnLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - logs:CreateLogStream
            - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: arn:aws:logs:eu-west-1:365470560685:log-group:/aws/lambda/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-sender:*
          - Sid: OwnQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
            - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            - sqs:DeleteMessage
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: arn:aws:sqs:eu-west-1:365470560685:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-outbound-queue
          - Fn::If:
            - GrantSocialSend
            - Sid: OnlyDemoPhone
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
              - social-messaging:SendWhatsAppMessage
              Resource: arn:aws:social-messaging:eu-west-1:365470560685:phone-number-id/b1e7f9e53c454f15be065a2e2b5a1f00
            - Ref: AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
Outputs:
  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt:
      - StageCloudFormationRole
      - Arn
  KmsRecoveryRoleArn:
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt:
      - KmsRecoveryRole
      - Arn
  InboundExecutionRoleArn:
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt:
      - InboundExecutionRole
      - Arn
  EnqueueExecutionRoleArn:
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt:
      - EnqueueExecutionRole
      - Arn
  SenderExecutionRoleArn:
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt:
      - SenderExecutionRole
      - Arn
Parameters:
  GrantSocialSend:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
    - 'false'
    - 'true'
    Description: Separate approval required; first receipt review must leave false
Conditions:
  GrantSocialSend:
    Fn::Equals:
    - Ref: GrantSocialSend
    - 'true'
Description: PROPOSAL ONLY. Modify only executor inline policy by one exact AWS SAM transform permission. No roles added.
